posts.title: I am going rafting
posts.description: I am packing my stuff to go rafting. It will take the whole extended weekend from Thursday evening to Sunday. I have worried about packing adn stuff for a while now, but best way to alleviate packing stress is by packing. Lets see if I stay dry!
